programs.name: Computer Science (Scarborough)
programs.notes: Degree offered: Bachelor of Computer Science (BCS). Program start: Fall 2027. Co-op option available. OUAC code TXC. Direct from high school only; applicants with any post-secondary education are not eligible.

tuition.label: Computer Science first-year fee — Ontario residents
tuition.notes: Published as the current-year (2026–27) first-year fee to help estimate fall 2027; the page says 2027–28 fees will be approved in spring 2027. Year 2 and up: CAD 11,420. Incidental and ancillary fees are additional (CAD 2,286 listed).

tuition.label: Computer Science first-year fee — domestic students outside Ontario
tuition.notes: Published as the current-year (2026–27) first-year fee to help estimate fall 2027; the page says 2027–28 fees will be approved in spring 2027. Year 2 and up: CAD 14,260. Incidental and ancillary fees are additional (CAD 2,286 listed).

tuition.label: Computer Science first-year fee — international students
tuition.notes: Published as the current-year (2026–27) first-year fee to help estimate fall 2027; the page says 2027–28 fees will be approved in spring 2027. Year 2 and up: CAD 72,480. Incidental and ancillary fees are additional (CAD 2,286 listed).

deadlines.notes: Application deadline listed in the international-student table. Early application date: 7 November 2026. Document deadline: 1 February 2027. The programme page is campus-specific (Scarborough).
Application deadline listed in the domestic-student table. Early application date: 7 November 2026. Document deadline: 1 February 2027. The programme page is campus-specific (Scarborough).

requirements.text: Ontario high school: Ontario Secondary School Diploma with at least six Grade 12 U or M courses, including English, Advanced Functions, and Calculus and Vectors. The page lists approximate grade requirements of a minimum 70% in English and low 90s overall (high 90s for co-op).

International high school: proof of high school diploma; requirements vary by country and school system. Required Grade 12 courses listed are English, Advanced Functions, and Calculus and Vectors. English-language proficiency proof may be necessary.
